title: PS5 Homebrew Compendium — Library Manifest
description: Schema for library.json, the library MANIFEST: site metadata, categories, redirects and the ordered list of platform definition files. Items itself no longer live here (schemaVersion 2.0.0); they live in each platform's items/ folder — see platform.schema.json and item.schema.json. The runtime loader still tolerates legacy flat `itemFiles` and inline `items` manifests for backward compatibility, but those shapes are NOT part of this target schema.

schemaVersion.description: Semver contract version of the library layout. Current: 2.0.0 (platform-based modular content). Minor = additive fields; major = breaking layout/field changes. The app tolerates unknown majors with a warning.

categories.description: Topic definitions shared across all platforms.

redirects.description: Map of old item id -> new item id, so old #/item/<old> deep links keep resolving after a rename.

items.description: Relative path to a platform definition file (e.g. "library/platforms/ps5/platform.json").

platforms.description: ORDERED list of platform definition files to load. A manifest is required because static hosts cannot list directories.

url.description: Only https URLs are accepted; the app renders anchors only for https (NFR-S1).

defaultFirmwareHint.description: Suggested default firmware value for the compatibility selector, e.g. "13.60".

id.description: Stable machine id used in routes (#/category/<id>) and item.category.

icon.description: Named icon key implemented in the app sprite (gamepad, unlock, tool, app, ...). Unknown keys fall back to a default glyph.
